cf_distance_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, detours and residual standoff from the assigned waypoint carry little penalty.

cf_distance_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_distance_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, shrink the geometric gap to the assigned waypoint as aggressively as practicable.

cf_energy_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, battery drain can be accepted in exchange for operational gains.

cf_energy_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_energy_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, guard the vehicles' state of charge throughout the sortie.

cf_collision_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, brief loss of deconfliction and contact exposure may be accepted.

cf_collision_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_collision_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, keep the flight free of physical contact and hazardous close encounters.

cf_safety_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, the formation may compress and operate with narrow buffers.

cf_safety_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_safety_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, keep the formation dispersed with broad protective buffers between vehicles.

cf_task_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, ending the sortie with unfinished assignments is tolerable.

cf_task_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_task_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, clear the entire assignment queue before the sortie ends.

cf_time_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, late responses and slower arrival may be tolerated.

cf_time_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_time_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, suppress response latency and arrive without avoidable delay.

cf_threat_low.description: With every other criterion unchanged, passage through sensor envelopes and watched airspace is allowed.

cf_threat_mid.description: Retain the default balance among navigation, resources, risk, and mission outcome.

cf_threat_high.description: With every other criterion unchanged, deny radar exposure and remain beyond monitored threat envelopes.
